metadata.title: CareConnect
metadata.description: Find a doctor and book an appointment near you.

site.notificationsBlocked: Blocked in your browser's site settings

directory.heading: Find a doctor
directory.heroSubtitle: Search by specialty, name, or clinic — see real availability and book an in-clinic visit in minutes.
directory.trust1Body: Every profile is checked and license-verified before it goes live.
directory.trust2Body: See actual open slots — no guessing, no back-and-forth calls.
directory.trust3Body: Walk in with a confirmed slot and skip the waiting-room lottery.
directory.empty: No practitioners found for this search.
directory.resultCount: {count, plural, =0 {No results} one {# result} other {# results}}

practitionerProfile.notFound: This practitioner could not be found.
practitionerProfile.reviewEligibilityNote: You can review a practitioner after checking in for an appointment with them.
practitionerProfile.loginToReview: Log in to leave a review

auth.heading: Log in or sign up
auth.subtitle: Enter your phone number and we'll send you a one-time code
auth.phoneHint: Pakistani numbers can start with 03 or +92
auth.error: Something went wrong. Please try again.
auth.roleUsePatient: This number belongs to a patient account. Select "I'm looking for a doctor" instead.
auth.roleUseProvider: This number belongs to a doctor account. Select "I'm a healthcare provider" instead.
auth.roleUseStaff: This number belongs to a receptionist account. Select "I'm clinic staff" instead.
auth.roleNotInvitedStaff: No clinic has added this number as a receptionist yet. Ask your clinic owner to invite you from their Staff page using this exact number, then try again.

patient.profileSaveError: Couldn't save your settings. Please try again.
patient.noFamilyMembers: You haven't added any family members yet.
patient.noSlots: No available slots for this date.

bookingError.unavailable: That time isn't available. Please choose an open slot.
bookingError.window: It's too close to this appointment to change it online. Please call the clinic.
bookingError.changed: This appointment can no longer be changed.

patient.joinWaitlist: Join the waitlist for this date
patient.noWaitlistEntries: You're not on any waitlist right now.
patient.cancelConfirmBody: The clinic will be told and the slot offered to someone else.

clinic.invitePrompt: Invite a receptionist or junior doctor by phone number. They sign in to CareConnect with that same number once you've invited them. A junior doctor also needs a practitioner profile.
clinic.inviteSuccess: Invite sent — they can now log in to CareConnect.
clinic.permissionsHeading: Pick a role to see exactly what it can reach
clinic.permissionsToggleHeading: Turn off anything they shouldn't be able to do

permissions.viewPatientList: See patient names, numbers and visit dates

clinic.assignmentsPrompt: A junior doctor only sees patients you've assigned to them here — not the whole practice.
clinic.noJuniorDoctors: Invite an active junior doctor above before assigning patients.
clinic.reviewedAllergiesLabel: I've reviewed this prescription against the allergies shown above.
clinic.reviewedNoAllergiesLabel: I've checked this patient's allergy record before prescribing.
clinic.allergyWarningBody: {drugs} may match something on this patient's recorded allergy list — this is a plain keyword match, not a clinical interaction check, so use your own judgment.
clinic.accessDenied: You don't have access to this page.
clinic.revenueDisclaimer: Visits × each doctor's current consultation fee — not a record of what was actually collected. CareConnect doesn't process payments.
clinic.noActivityYet: No appointment activity in this window yet.
clinic.reviewsPrompt: Reviews left by patients you've treated. Report one that violates guidelines for a platform admin to review.
clinic.reportReasonLabel: Why are you reporting this review?
clinic.attachRecordPrompt: Match it to the visit it belongs to, not just a name — safer when two patients share one.
clinic.verificationScopeNote: Upload the documents an admin needs to verify you — your CNIC, degree, and council registration certificate.

workingHours.heading: Working hours
workingHours.intro: Patients can only book the times you set here. Slots are created automatically from these hours.
workingHours.ownerOnly: Only the clinic owner can set working hours.
workingHours.notSetBody: You haven't saved working hours at this clinic, so you don't appear in the directory. Check the hours below, enter your fee and press Save.
workingHours.setUpLink: Set your working hours so patients can book you →
workingHours.saved: Working hours saved. Patients can now book these times.
workingHours.feeHint: Shown to patients before they book.
workingHours.slotLengthHint: Each day's hours are split into slots of this length.
workingHours.dailyCapHint: Stop taking bookings for a day once this many are booked. Leave empty for no limit.
workingHours.cancellationHint: Patients can cancel online until this many hours before the appointment.
workingHours.activeHint: Untick to pause online bookings at this clinic without losing your hours.
workingHours.weekHint: Pakistan time. Tick the days you see patients and set up to two sittings per day, e.g. morning and evening. Leave the second sitting blank if you don't need it.
workingHours.errorHalfRange: {day}: fill in both a start and an end time, or clear both.
workingHours.errorNoTimes: {day} is ticked as open but has no times. Add a time or untick the day.

clinic.reportSent: Report sent. Our team will review it.
clinic.revokeConfirmBody: They'll no longer be able to open this clinic. You can invite them again later.

vault.heading: My records
vault.empty: You haven't added any records yet.
vault.noMedicalSummary: No allergies, conditions, or blood group on file yet.
vault.addRecordHint: Upload a file, or scan a paper document with your camera. Scanned pages are saved together as one PDF.
vault.cameraUnavailable: The camera isn't available. Allow camera access in your browser, or take or choose photos instead.
vault.pagesCount: {count, plural, =0 {no pages yet} one {# page} other {# pages}}
vault.noPagesHint: Capture each page of the document. You can rotate, reorder or remove pages before saving.
vault.scanTooLarge: This scan is too large to upload (10 MB limit). Remove some pages and try again.
vault.scanFailed: Couldn't save the scan. Please try again.
vault.maxPagesReached: That's the 20-page limit for one scan.
vault.reviewDetected: Page found, cropped and straightened. Adjust the corners if anything's cut off.
vault.reviewNotDetected: Couldn't find the page edges, so the whole photo is used. Adjust the corners to crop it.
vault.previewHint: This is exactly how your pages will be saved. Edit, reorder or remove any page first.
vault.cornersHint: Drag the four corners onto the corners of the page.

sharedRecord.heading: Shared medical record
sharedRecord.invalidBody: It may have expired or been revoked by the patient.
sharedRecord.neverExpiresLabel: This link stays open until the patient revokes it
sharedRecord.noMedicalSummary: No allergies, conditions, or blood group on file.
sharedRecord.noVisitHistory: No visit history included in this share.
sharedRecord.noRecords: No records included in this share.
sharedRecord.footerNote: Shared read-only via CareConnect — opening this link has been logged.

admin.heading: Practitioner verification
admin.scopeNote: Reviews the registration number and details a practitioner submitted, plus any CNIC/degree/registration-certificate documents they've uploaded below.
admin.accessDenied: You don't have access to this page.
admin.reviewsScopeNote: A doctor can report a review of themselves; hiding it removes it from the public directory without deleting it — a moderation *mechanism*, not a policy on what's reportable (that's still an open product decision).
admin.rejectBody: They'll see your reason and can submit again.

onboarding.roleHeading: How would you like to use CareConnect?
onboarding.patientOptionDesc: Book appointments, manage your family's health records, and more.
onboarding.practitionerOptionDesc: Register your practice and get discovered by patients near you.
onboarding.staffNote: Clinic staff? You can't sign up on your own. Your clinic owner adds you from their Staff page, then you sign in with that same phone number and choose "I'm clinic staff".
onboarding.specialtiesRequired: Please pick at least one specialty.
onboarding.error: Something went wrong. Please try again.
onboarding.becomeProviderLink: Register as a healthcare provider instead

account.heading: Delete your account
account.permanentBody: Your account is deleted straight away and can't be recovered. If you sign up again with the same number you'll start a brand-new account.
account.ownerClinics: Your clinic ({clinics}) will be closed and removed from CareConnect, along with its appointments and staff access.
account.ownerUpcoming: {count, plural, one {# upcoming appointment} other {# upcoming appointments}} at your clinic will be cancelled, and those patients will be notified.
account.practitionerProfile: Your doctor profile, reviews and verification documents will be deleted, and you'll be removed from the directory.
account.staffAccess: You'll lose access to the clinics you work at. Notes and vitals you recorded stay with those clinics.
account.patientData: Your profile, your family members' details, the records you uploaded, your share links and your reviews will be deleted.
account.patientUpcoming: {count, plural, one {Your # upcoming appointment} other {Your # upcoming appointments}} will be cancelled.
account.patientRecordsKept: Clinics that treated you keep their own visit records (notes, prescriptions, vitals), with your name removed.
account.login: Your login is deleted and you'll be signed out.
account.confirmMismatch: Please type DELETE exactly to confirm.
account.deleteFailed: Your account couldn't be deleted. Please try again.

refused.title: Not shown
refused.body: We couldn't record this access, so the medical information wasn't shown. Please try again in a moment.

saved.title: Saved, but not recorded
saved.body: Your change was saved, but we couldn't record it in the access log. Please don't submit it again.
